title: rekordbox collection
howTo: In rekordbox, choose File > Export Collection in xml format, then choose the file here.

older.message: This export is older than your last read of the rekordbox database. The export was saved {{xmlAt}}; the database was read {{readAt}}. Reading the export would replace the newer information.

failed.damaged: The export is cut off or damaged. Export it again from rekordbox.

error.xmlOlderThanDatabaseRead: This export (saved {{xmlAt}}) is older than your last read of the rekordbox database ({{readAt}}), so it was not read.
error.sendNeedsExport: Sending needs a rekordbox XML export. Export one from rekordbox, then choose it here.
